about.title: About
about.firstDescription: My experience in the scientific field and my passions (teaching, sports and electronics) have gradually made me interested in programming, to the point that my most precious long-term achievement is being able to integrate them into a software project that adds value and allows a problem to be solved.
about.secondDescription: Currently, I have strong experience working on React, Java, and Node.js projects. I've built frontend applications from scratch using microfrontend architecture and have contributed to improving performance and security across several applications.
